signals.retired_note: RETIRED, NOT DELETED. The horizon-matched Donchian was this project's signal source until 2026-09-10, when the Rayo Scalper replaced it everywhere: live alerts, the Signal Board, the side panel and the settings modal all read `scalper` now, and the two Windows tasks that polled this rule (DiaNurFx Signal Alert, DiaNurFx-Signal-XAUUSD-15m) are disabled. Every cell below is kept with its grade and its pre-registered OOS/IS numbers intact because this was a live forward test opened 2026-09-08 -- deleting a registration two days into it would destroy the only record of what was predicted before the fact. Nothing reads these cells; they are here to be scored, not traded.
